title: MV Point and Click system that uses pictures, and has image-specific events(?)

posts.author: Dreamzzz
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Plugins
Maker Format:
MV
Makers I Own:
MV
Description:
I'm trying to make a point and click system,
BUT
my game is going to be using
exclusively pictures
. So using event squares makes no sense. I also haven't messed with the mouse at all, so I'm kind of hopelessly lost.
If I'm understanding this right, I only need 2-3 plugins that work with each other.
- a mouse system that can interact with event pictures. (I know of Galenmereth's one, but I'm not sure if it would work like this??)
- a plugin that lets you make images (pictures, not event tiles) into clickable events that lead to their own unique page (not a common event) AND still have the ability to overlay them with the numbering system rpgmaker uses.
- a way to get the event pictures to ONLY start the event that's been clicked, and not also progress the text on screen.
I'm going to be overlaying pictures. One "main" fullscreen picture, like a table. Plus one "clickable" picture that's on top of it. Like a book or something. The clickable image wont take up the entire screen, because then the entire screen will be the image event. It will be small, and placed manually so it "blends in" to the fullscreen picture, and has the ability to have hover effects.
BUT- if everything is using pictures, and you're clicking the screen, to my understanding that will also progress the default text? So, how do I end up making a system where clicking things ONLY triggers the clickable event and nothing else, and clicking anywhere that isn't within the boundaries of the clickable image, will continue to progress the text the way rpgmaker does normally?
Also I cant seem to find a plugin
(or one that I understand)
that allows for pictures to be made into events that lead into their own page. I know people use images for UI and they connect common events to them so it can open and close, lead to where it needs to, and all that- but I'm not sure how to go about leading it to its own unique page, without the use of common events.
I apologize if this is something super simple that I've just misunderstood completely, or if this makes very little sense. I'm trying to explain the best way I can, and I'm still very new to this engine, and can't code. So I'm fully relying on plugins to do all the fancy stuff. Anything to point me in the right direction would be super appreciated!

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
You will not find any plugins that turns pictures into events. What you will find, and need, its just one plugin that let you better interact with pictures.
When you hover, click, enter, leave a picture with the cursor, something happens. Usually, stores the picture ID into a variable.
When that variable value higher than 0, it means that somehow a picture interaction happened. Then, you will run a regular or common event, parallel or autorun, that will do things related to that picture.
You cxan either use a conditional branch or use the event page conditions to tier that variable.
Variable is just an example. Could be also a switch.
My point is, you need to look for a plugin that let you interact with pictrures with the mouse cursor, and somehow that plugin must give you a way to know what kind of interaction happened and the picture id.
From that forward, is just a matter of eventing.

posts.author: coucassi
posts.body:
Tamschis
OnTouch
Plugin may have some functionalities you could put to use. I think you'll still have to use events with this, but the plugin will allow you to click their sprites inestead of the tiles they are on. Since the transparent pixels are ignored, it should work the same as clicking a picture, if you just set the picture as the events sprite.
He also lists integration fpr his
Dynamic Pictures
Plugin, so maybe it's even possible to use pictures instead of events, but I am not sure about that.
